lines.opener: *a tiny king with a crooked back and the face of an angel steps out of the moonlight* God keep you, fair friend. I greet you kindly. Answer me, and quickly.
lines.openerHostile: *thunder mutters overhead; the wind rises* You would not answer me? Then answer THIS.
lines.like: *his face lights like a summer morning* By my faith, well said!
lines.dislike: *thunder rolls somewhere close* Have a care how you speak to a king.
lines.hate: *the cup in his hand runs dry* A liar. I have no more to say to you. *and he is gone, with a clap of thunder*
lines.flirt: *a royal, amused smile* Bold! I like bold. Titania would be furious. Say it again.
lines.join: *he blows one soft note on an ivory horn* I take you under my protection, fair friend. Keep faith and never lie to me, and none shall harm you.
lines.demand: A tribute, fair friend. A small thing, befitting a king.
lines.gift: *he presses a little golden cup into your hands; it brims with wine* Drink. It fills only for the honest. Mind it stays full.
lines.letPass: *he steps aside with a sweep of his cloak* Pass, and go with God.
lines.neutral: *he waits, turning a little cup in his fingers*
lines.ai: *his eyes narrow* I know not this word. If it is mockery, it is ill-chosen.
lines.refuseJoin: You presume to ASK? A king chooses whom he protects.
lines.leaveNow: *he turns into the moonlight* Titania is waiting, and her temper is worse than mine.
